title: P0: Main Chat spec — 7 normative bugs
description: 1. Broken refs: {{peer-deliver}}, {{peer-groupupdate}}, {{JMAP-VTC-WSS}} undefined. 2. Chat/set create returning existing in updated violates RFC 8620. 3. readAt/deletedAt/deletedForAll marked server-set but client-writable. 4. Contradictory MUST: servers reject unknown spans BUT clients must ignore. 5. Space/join never checks SpaceBan. 6. mention_broadcast unenforceable for non-Space group chats. 7. Custom error types rateLimited/notPermitted not IANA-registered.
